decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its depth, scale, height, position and design, would cause an overbearing impact, increase sense of enclosure, loss of outlook and light on the amenities of the occupiers of 409 Kingston Road. The proposal therefore fails to comply with Policies D12.3 and D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024, London Plan Policy D4, and the National Planning Policy Framework 2024.

Reason : 2 - The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its depth, scale, height, position and design, would cause a harmful impact on the streetscape of Oxford Avenue, be an overdevelopment of the host site, and be out of keeping with the host property and its surroundings. The proposal therefore fails to comply with Policies D12.3 and D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024, London Plan Policy D4, and the National Planning Policy Framework 2024.

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was not considered to comply with the provisions of the Development Plan and NPPF 2024  as submitted, and would have required substantial changes such that a new application would be required. 
"	 
"	The application was considered to be fundamentally contrary to the provisions of the Development Plan and the NPPF 2024, and there were not considered to be any solutions to resolve this conflict. 
"	It is noted that the applicant/agent did not engage in any pre-application discussions.
"	The applicant is advised to seek pre-application advice on any resubmission.
description: APPLICATION FOR A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION.
